column1: # Where each woven Spanish verb form in lex-es.tsv was read.
# A verb row weaves its second form under an English -ing, and the tooltip
# prints that form as the word the reader met. Spanish weaves the gerund,
# the gerundio of "estoy diciendo", not a present participle: the seed's
# header said "present participle" for every language until 2026-10-08.
# That day every woven Spanish form was read in the "gerund" row of the
# conjugation table on English Wiktionary's Spanish entry for its verb,
# rendered as a reader sees it, because a verb's headword line prints none
# of its gerunds. All 80 are the form their verb's table prints, and none
# quote is the row's label and its cell, as printed. One infinitive is
# pronominal and has no table of its own: sentarse's entry says only
# "infinitive of sentar combined with se". The pack weaves the gerund
# without the pronoun, sentando, because se may stand before the verb that
# carries it, "se está sentando", so its line cites sentarse's entry and
# Whether that form answers to every English -ing it is woven under — the
